name: Nebius Token Factory
short: Nebius AI Cloud inference platform for open-weight models, with a one-time trial credit on first sign-up.

plans.name: Trial credit
plans.notes: A small one-time trial credit on sign-up has been reported, but the official billing guide does not document it (could not verify the amount or a 30-day validity as of 2026-11-09). Verified: billing setup with a bank card is mandatory during onboarding before any usage; promo codes provide free credits, usually with an expiration date. Serverless models are deprecated on a published schedule - on 2026-11-09 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B were removed from Serverless (Dedicated Endpoints unaffected).

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Serverless endpoints billed by token usage; promo codes can add free credits.
